pages.name: Privacy Policy
pages.title: Privacy Policy · FeastoX
pages.description: How FeastoX collects, uses and protects information about restaurants, their staff and their diners.
pages.intro: This policy explains what {{company}} ("FeastoX", "we") collects when restaurants, their staff and diners use the FeastoX website and the FeastoX mobile app, why, and the choices you have. Last updated {{updated}}.

sections.p: Restaurant owners and staff who create an account or sign in on the website or in the FeastoX app, and diners who open a restaurant’s menu by scanning a QR code. For diner data, the restaurant decides why the data is collected, and we process it for the restaurant.

Your name, email address, phone number, profile photo if you add one, restaurant details, menu, prices, tables, staff accounts and their roles, orders, sales and accounting records you enter, the time of your last sign-in, and the actions recorded in your audit log. Your sign-in PIN is stored only as a salted hash, never as the PIN itself. For subscriptions we keep the plan, invoices and payment reference. Payment card or wallet credentials are handled by the payment provider, not stored by us.

The app is for restaurant staff. It keeps your sign-in session in your phone’s secure storage. If you allow notifications, we store a push notification token for your phone, together with the branch you are working in, so we can alert you to new orders. The app asks for Bluetooth permission to find and connect to receipt and kitchen printers. On older versions of Android the system also requires the location permission before an app may scan for Bluetooth devices; FeastoX does not read, collect or store your location. The app can keep your screen awake while it is open, and it reads only the photos you choose to upload for a dish or your profile. You can turn any permission off in your phone’s settings; the feature that needs it, such as printing or order alerts, then stops working.

Dining at a table needs no account. We create an anonymous session tied to the restaurant and table so your cart, orders and one review per dish stay together. For delivery or pick-up we ask for a name and phone number, and a delivery address where needed. Ratings and comments you leave are linked to the dish you ordered and shown as verified.

To run the service: show menus, take and track orders, send order alerts to staff, show ratings, bill subscriptions, keep records, prevent misuse, fix problems and improve the product. We do not sell personal information, and we do not use it for advertising.

The restaurant you order from sees your orders, and your name and phone number if you gave them. Ratings are shown to the restaurant and to other diners without your phone number. We share data with service providers that host the service or process payments, and with Google, whose Firebase Cloud Messaging service delivers push notifications to staff phones. They receive only what is needed to provide that service. We also share data where the law requires.
We use browser storage to keep your session, cart and preferences. We do not use it for advertising.

We keep restaurant records while the account is active and for the period the law or legitimate business needs require afterwards. Order records keep the dish name and price as they were at the time of the order. Sales, payment, ledger and audit records also keep the name of the staff member who made each entry as it was at that time, so receipts and books still read correctly; when a staff account is deleted these records stay with the restaurant and are not removed. Ask us to delete personal data and we will, unless we must keep it.

Staff can delete their own account in the FeastoX app: open the More tab, tap your profile at the top, scroll to the bottom, choose Delete my account and enter your sign-in PIN. If you cannot use the app, follow the steps at feastox.com/delete-account. Deleting removes your name, email address, phone number, profile photo, sign-in details and push notification tokens, and signs you out for good. The restaurant’s own records are kept, as described under How long we keep it. If you are the only owner of a restaurant, make someone else an owner first, or ask us to close the restaurant and its data.

Prices and totals are recalculated on our servers, PINs are stored as salted hashes, access is limited by role, and sensitive changes are recorded in an audit log. Data travels between the app, the website and our servers over encrypted connections. No system is perfectly secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

You can ask to see, correct or delete personal information we hold about you. Staff can correct their name, phone number and photo in the app. Diners should first contact the restaurant. Contact us at {{email}}.
FeastoX is built for restaurants and their staff. It is not aimed at children, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them.
We will update this page when the policy changes and change the date at the top.

pages.name: Terms and Conditions
pages.title: Terms and Conditions · FeastoX
pages.description: The terms for using FeastoX: accounts, subscriptions, acceptable use and responsibilities.
pages.intro: These terms govern use of FeastoX, provided by {{company}} ("FeastoX", "we"). By creating an account or using the service you agree to them. Last updated {{updated}}.

sections.p: FeastoX provides software for restaurants: QR menus and ordering, a POS, kitchen display, inventory, accounts, delivery tools and dish ratings. Features available to you depend on your plan.

The person who creates a restaurant account is its owner and is responsible for the accounts they give to staff, for keeping sign-in details secure, and for what is done under the account. Information you give us must be accurate.

A new restaurant starts with a free trial. After the trial a paid plan is billed monthly or yearly in NPR, with extra branches and staff seats charged as shown on the pricing page. Plans and prices may change, and we will tell you before a change reaches your next period. If a payment is missed, access may be restricted or suspended as described in the dashboard. Refunds are covered in the Refund Policy.

You are responsible for your menu, prices, taxes, availability, food quality and safety, and for fulfilling the orders placed with you. FeastoX is software and is not a party to the sale between a restaurant and its diners. Receipts produced by FeastoX are guest copies and are not tax invoices unless the product states otherwise, so you remain responsible for meeting your own tax and billing obligations.
Only diners with a completed order containing a dish can rate it. You may not pay for, fake, or pressure diners into particular ratings, and we may remove ratings that break these rules.
Do not use FeastoX unlawfully, to harm others, to attack or overload the service, to access data that is not yours, or to resell it without our written consent.
We work to keep FeastoX running, but we do not promise it will be uninterrupted or error-free. Keep your own backups of records you cannot afford to lose, such as exports of your sales.

You can cancel at any time and your plan continues until the end of the paid period. We may suspend or end accounts that break these terms or are unpaid. On request we will give you an export of your records before an account is closed.
To the extent the law allows, FeastoX is not liable for indirect or consequential loss, and our total liability for any claim is limited to the fees you paid us in the three months before it arose.
These terms are governed by the laws of Nepal, and the courts of Nepal have jurisdiction.
Questions: {{email}}. We may update these terms and will change the date at the top. Continuing to use the service after an update means you accept it.

pages.name: Refund Policy
pages.title: Refund Policy · FeastoX
pages.description: When FeastoX subscription payments are refunded, and how to ask.
pages.intro: This policy covers FeastoX subscription payments made by restaurants. Last updated {{updated}}.

sections.p: Every new restaurant starts on a free trial and is not charged during it. Use it to check that FeastoX suits your restaurant before you pay.

We refund a charge that was made in error, was taken twice, or was larger than the invoice. We will refund within a reasonable time to the payment method used, or credit the amount to your next invoice if you prefer.
If your first paid period was a mistake, ask within 7 days of the payment and we will refund it in full, as long as the account has not used the service beyond its normal trial activity.

Subscription fees are otherwise not refunded for a period already started, including part-months, yearly plans partly used, or periods in which you did not use the service. Extra branches and staff seats added during a period are charged for that period.
You can cancel at any time. Your plan continues until the end of the period you paid for and does not renew. Downgrades take effect at the end of the paid period.
A month added to your plan through a referral has no cash value and cannot be refunded.
Email {{email}} with your restaurant name and the invoice number, and tell us what went wrong. We will reply with the outcome.

pages.name: Delete Account
pages.title: Delete your FeastoX account · FeastoX
pages.description: How to delete your FeastoX account from the mobile app or by email, what is deleted, what is kept and for how long.
pages.intro: This page explains how to delete your account in the FeastoX mobile app by {{company}}, and what happens to your data when you do. It applies to staff and owners who sign in to FeastoX on the app or the website. Last updated {{updated}}.

sections.h: Delete your account in the app
sections.p: Open the FeastoX app and sign in. Go to the More tab and tap your profile at the top. Scroll to the bottom and choose Delete my account. Enter your sign-in PIN and confirm. The deletion happens straight away and you are signed out.

sections.h: If you cannot use the app
sections.p: Email {{email}} from the email address on your FeastoX account, with the subject Delete my FeastoX account. Tell us the restaurant you work at. We may reply to that address to confirm the request is yours. We will never ask for your PIN. We delete the account within 30 days of your request and confirm by email when it is done. This route is also for staff whose restaurant is suspended and so cannot sign in to the app.

Your name, email address, phone number, profile photo, sign-in PIN and approval PIN, and the push notification tokens of your phones. You can no longer sign in, on the app or the website, and your access to every restaurant you belonged to is removed.

sections.h: What we keep, and for how long
sections.p: The restaurant’s own business records are not deleted: orders, sales, payments, accounting entries and the audit log. Entries you made keep the staff name as it was when they were recorded, so receipts and books stay accurate, but they no longer link to a working account. The restaurant keeps these for as long as its account is active and for the period the law or legitimate business needs require afterwards, such as tax and accounting records and preventing fraud or misuse.

If you are the only owner of a restaurant, the app will not delete your account until another person is made an owner, so the restaurant is never left without one. To close a restaurant and have its data deleted, email {{email}} from the owner’s email address. We delete it within 30 days, except records we must keep by law.

Diners do not have accounts. If you gave a name, phone number or address with a delivery or pick-up order, ask the restaurant first. You can also email {{email}} with the restaurant’s name and the details you gave, and we will delete personal information we are not required to keep.
